As a global medtech company, we are driven by our Vision of changing the trajectory of lives for a new day and our Mission to create ingenious solutions that ignite patient turnarounds. Our relentless commitment to patients and strong legacy of innovation in healthcare are the foundation of our future. If you're looking for a new chance, a new beginning, a new trajectory, LivaNova is where your talent can truly thrive. Join our talented team members worldwide to become a pioneer of tomorrow—because at LivaNova, we don’t just treat conditions — we aspire to alter the course of lives. Location: Remote – Europe (Italy, France, Germany, Spain or the UK) Travel: At least 50% About The Role At LivaNova, we are looking for a Senior Global Marketing Manager – Digital Solutions to drive the global marketing strategy for our digital solutions portfolio, with a strong focus on software, data and value-based healthcare. This is an opportunity to bring a fresh perspective to the way digital solutions are positioned, launched and developed in a global healthcare environment. You will work with global stakeholders and lead a team of two product management professionals, helping translate digital capabilities into compelling market propositions and sustainable business opportunities. Responsibilities Define and drive the global marketing strategy for the digital solutions portfolio, with a focus on software, data and value-based healthcare. Lead software commercialization activities, translating product capabilities into compelling value propositions and go-to-market strategies. Support the launch and growth of digital products, leveraging software business models such as Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) and recurring revenue. Collaborate with global and cross-functional stakeholders to align product positioning, marketing priorities and commercialization plans. Identify opportunities to strengthen the value proposition of digital solutions and communicate their relevance to customers and the healthcare environment. Lead and support two direct reports Your Profile Proven experience in Product Marketing, Product Management or a related commercial role, with hands-on experience launching software products. Strong understanding of software business models, particularly SaaS, subscriptions and recurring revenue. Experience developing product positioning, value propositions and go-to-market strategies. Strong communication, strategic thinking and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across global teams. Some people management experience is desirable; the ability and motivation to develop as a leader are also valued. Willingness to travel internationally at least 50% of the time and flexibility to work across global time zones when required. Proximity to an international airport is an advantage. What We Can Offer You In addition to providing you with a supportive, inclusive and collaborative environment where you will feel empowered to take ownership and drive meaningful change, we will reward you with competitive, market-aligned packages across all locations. Actual compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, qualifications, and internal equity. Segnala offerta di lavoro Legora ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da Legora. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 60.520,00 €/yr - 71.200,00 €/anno About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. About The Role The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the center of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced, strategic Engagement Manager to join our growing team and help a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams fundamentally change the way they work with Legora. This is a role for someone who has managed a high-volume portfolio through a one-to-many model, and who knows that transformation across a large portfolio of clients has to be designed, automated and measured. You will drive adoption, technical health and commercial outcomes of your portfolio end-to-end by leveraging systems and technology while reserving high-touch interactions for the most impactful moments. You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption program at Legora, helping clients realize measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work. What You'll Do You'll own the post-sale motion end-to-end for a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams across our EMEA scaled portfolio. Specifically, you will: Improve the one-to-many adoption playbook: the tech-led onboarding, enablement, and change-management motions and target outcomes for how our scaled customers adopt Legora and transform the way they work. Execute against that playbook, sequencing automated touchpoints and interventions from initial rollout to firm-wide adoption, and adapting as the client's needs and Legora's capabilities evolve. Facilitate strategic touchpoints with your highest stakes accounts, while using one-to-many enablement to surface high-impact opportunities and guide the rest of the portfolio toward maximum value from Legora. Drive sustained value through a programmatic operating cadence: templated success plans, one-to-many enablement, scaled training and digital value reviews. Manage the health of the portfolio by monitoring adoption and utilization signals in our internal systems to proactively flag and act on risks and growth opportunities. Own the commercials for the scaled program end-to-end by running renewal and expansion as repeatable motions informed by exquisite portfolio hygiene, forecasting, and data utilization. Orchestrate engagement across cross-functional teams (Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Product Marketing, Support) to accelerate client success, maintaining end-to-end portfolio context and coordination. Translate scaled customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and Product Marketing to inform roadmap, positioning, and enablement, and to represent the voice of the scaled segment. What We Offer: You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation at scale has to be designed, automated and measured. You're proactive, systems-minded and comfortable making tradeoffs about where to intervene and where to let technology do the work. You take pride in being the reason customers adopt, grow and succeed. We're Looking For: A scaled customer success, renewal management, or customer education background, with a demonstrated track record of designing and delivering programs that serve large customer bases through a one-to-many model. Experience building repeatable adoption playbooks and educational programs and delivering them at scale across digital channels. 3+ years for Manager, 5+ years for Senior Manager, in scaled or digital customer success, customer operations, account management, or a related field, ideally with exposure to high-growth B2B AI verticals or Legal Tech. Leveling will depend on specific experience and fit for the segment. A track record of driving adoption, retention and expansion with a high-volume portfolio of clients, without individual coverage of every account. Ownership of a commercial number: you have carried GRR and NRR for a portfolio and run renewal and expansion yourself as repeatable motions, hitting the thresholds by leveraging data and automation. Technical fluency and systems thinking: you're comfortable configuring and deploying tooling (CS and CRM platforms, AI agents, LMS, data visualization platforms) to deliver outcomes. Data fluency and a metrics-driven approach to customer health, forecasting and portfolio strategy at scale. Exceptional program, project and prioritization skills; you keep many clients and multi-workstream initiatives moving concurrently. Excellent Italian and English communication skills — written, verbal, and interpersonal. High EQ: you know when to listen, when to advise and when to act. A love of fast-paced, early-stage environments where you help build the playbook, not just follow it. What We Offer: The opportunity to join and grow within Legora’s SMB post-sale engagement team in EMEA. A role with real ownership of customer outcomes and visibility across product, go-to-market, and support functions. Collaboration with leadership and cross-functional teams to build systems that shape customer outcomes. A fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where excellence is rewarded, and growth is exponential. Competitive compensation, meaningful equity participation, with a culture focussed on high performance. Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Who We Are At JD.com, also known as JINGDONG, we are building one of the world’s most trusted technology and supply chain ecosystems. What started as a bold idea in China has evolved into a NASDAQ-listed, Fortune 44 global enterprise serving over 700 million active customers. Powered by advanced logistics, innovative technology, and a commitment to integrity, JD.com operates across retail, logistics, technology, property and more, creating solutions that make everyday life smarter, faster, and more connected. Our Global Reach JD.com is expanding its international footprint through a digitally intelligent, cross-border supply chain and world-class logistics network, supported by platforms such as Joybuy, which brings trusted products to customers worldwide. Today, our teams operate across China, the U.S., U.K., Netherlands, France, Germany, Spain, Brazil, Hungary, Japan, South Korea, Australia, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, the UAE and beyond, reaching customers in every corner of the world. Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://corporate.jd.com/ What We Offer Joining JD.com means becoming part of a company where people, innovation, and impact go hand in hand. We offer a competitive salary, a great location, and a supportive, people-first culture where your growth truly matters. With access to global projects, learning opportunities, and an inclusive environment that values every voice, you’ll have the space to shape the future with us. About The Team You’ll be joining the JD.com team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. The Role Develop, maintain, and optimize relationships with 3P sellers aligned with Joybuy’s marketplace strategy. You will have an opportunity to influence the evolution of the e-commerce sector within a high-performance, inclusive environment. As a key part of our team, you’ll dive into the fast-paced world of online retail to help our sellers grow and succeed. This isn’t just a job—it’s a chance to build strong professional relationships and help shape the future of e-commerce. You’ll use your skills to scale businesses and make a real impact, all while expanding your own career and expertise in a supportive, collaborative environment. What You'll Do Look for new businesses and guide them through the entire process of setting up their shop. Work closely with everyone from big, well-known brands to small, creative businesses to keep them successful. Help sellers use tools and services to grow their business across different product categories. Look at market trends and internal numbers to spot new ways for sellers to improve. Team up with different departments to create solutions that are good for both sellers and customers. Stay on track to meet your goals for managing and growing seller accounts. Keep up with what’s happening in your product area to understand customers and the competition. Pass on what you learn from sellers to the internal teams to help make the marketplace better for everyone. About You Experience in account management and sales Experience in building long-term B2B partnerships Strong understanding of Italy/EU marketplace and sellers Comfortable analysing complex data and providing actionable recommendations. Structured, performance-oriented, and able to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders, including international teams. Excellent communication skills in English and Italian At JD.com, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ready to apply? Take the next step in your career, apply now and explore the opportunities we have to offer.
